ei.title: 함축 의미 추론 — 고객 만족과 수익의 균형
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고2

fullPassage: For companies interested in delighting customers, exceptional value and service become part of the overall company culture. For example, year after year, Pazano ranks at or near the top of the hospitality industry in terms of customer satisfaction. The company’s passion for satisfying customers is summed up in its credo, which promises that its luxury hotels will deliver a truly memorable experience. Although a customercentered firm seeks to deliver high customer satisfaction relative to competitors, it does not attempt to maximize customer satisfaction. A company can always increase customer satisfaction by lowering its price or increasing its services. But this may result in lower profits. Thus, the purpose of marketing is to generate customer value profitably. This requires a very delicate balance: the marketer must continue to generate more customer value and satisfaction but not ‘give away the house’.

det.tip: generate customer value = 고객 가치를 창출하다

questions.passage: For companies interested in delighting customers, exceptional value and service become part of the overall company culture. For example, year after year, Pazano ranks at or near the top of the hospitality industry in terms of customer satisfaction. The company’s passion for satisfying customers is summed up in its credo, which promises that its luxury hotels will deliver a truly memorable experience. Although a customercentered firm seeks to deliver high customer satisfaction relative to competitors, it does not attempt to maximize customer satisfaction. A company can always increase customer satisfaction by lowering its price or increasing its services. But this may result in lower profits. Thus, the purpose of marketing is to generate customer value profitably. This requires a very delicate balance: the marketer must continue to generate more customer value and satisfaction but not ‘give away the house’.
questions.stem: 위 글에서 마케터가 지켜야 할 균형의 핵심을 설명하는 비유적 표현을 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (영어로) (4단어)

det.korean: 집을 내주다 = 너무 많이 퍼주다(비유적 표현)
det.analysis: 본문: 'but not give away the house' — 마케터가 가치와 만족을 창출하되 너무 많이 퍼주면 안 된다는 비유.
det.tip: give away the house = 너무 많이 퍼주다/모든 것을 내주다
